subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
13.  The management of Y Limited has provided the following information:

Opening stock of raw material

-
` 25,000

Closing stock of raw material

-
` 75,000

Raw material consumed during the year
-
` 7,50,000

What will be the number of days for which average inventory of raw material
is to be held by Y Limited? Assume 360 days in a year.
(A)  14 days
(B)  15 days
(C)  24 days
(D)  26 days
(2 Marks)
